r1_item_scope_table.semantics: Rule semantics = per-entry scope adjudication (replacing whole-source-file batch exclusion): the 6 retinal neuron classes (Rod/Cone/BC/AC/HC/RGC) plus MG/Astro/Micro/RPE (10 classes × 3 carrier files = 30 rows in total) carry scope=retina_only → excluded from kb_marker_ranking when assembling ocular-surface evidence, with no exhaustiveness claim about hit sources; unified identity naming MG = Müller glia (RLBP1/GLUL/SOX9/S100B), Astro = astrocyte (GFAP/AQP4/SLC1A3), Micro = microglia (C1QB); reciprocally, the 4 new entries carry scope=ocular_surface_only → retinal material excluded (neighborhood fire-audit grid-2 rule arm: 0 demonstrated leaks). Exclusion basis = tissue anatomy + cell lineage; absence from an author's vocabulary is never proof of biological non-existence.
